label: Original-phase steps 5-6, boosted after t/y/c/v/x/s in the last two inputs
explanation: Positional feature that fires almost only during the original input phase at absolute steps 5 and 6 (98% of activation mass; a little at steps 4 and 7). It is silent on steps 0-3, on steps 8 and later, at the delimiter (except a trace) and in the whole copy phase. Inside steps 5-6 it fires on only about a third of steps, and whether it fires depends on recent input content. It fires most often when the previous input or the one before it is one of t, y, c, v, x, s (rates 8-10% vs 3% base when the previous token is one of these), and the strongest activations follow sequences that contain c/t/y/2. Step position alone: dev P 0.32, R 0.96, mass recall 0.98. Adding the recent-token condition: dev P 0.60, R 0.64, F1 0.62, mass recall 0.77. The remaining dependence on content looks spread across many tokens and was not captured by any simple rule.
